portal.subtitle: A model aggregation gateway and usage-data curation platform. Clients talk to one address and one model alias — never to vendor quirks.
portal.feature.single_endpoint.title: One address, every model
portal.feature.single_endpoint.desc: Switch models by changing an alias. Vendor quirks stay hidden.
portal.feature.sessions.title: Every chat is saved as a session
portal.feature.sessions.desc: Review and rate it anytime, or share it with a link.
portal.feature.export_cli.title: One command sets up your clients
portal.feature.export_cli.desc: No more copying addresses and keys by hand.
portal.feature.usage.title: Usage and spend at a glance
portal.feature.usage.desc: Every call is recorded, so trends and costs are easy to read.
portal.feature.self_heal.title: Failing upstreams are contained
portal.feature.self_heal.desc: A failing upstream is isolated and let back in once it recovers.
portal.feature.dataset.title: Turn good chats into training data
portal.feature.dataset.desc: Filter by rating, model and date, then export in one click.
portal.feature.art.chat_user: Add unit tests for this handler
portal.eco.title: Works with the clients and model vendors you already use
portal.flow.heading: One request, through Aris
portal.flow.subtitle: Clients only know one address. Aris handles routing and protocol differences.
portal.caps.heading: Connect, keep, govern, withstand
portal.caps.subtitle: One gateway sits in front of every upstream, and every conversation becomes a data asset.
portal.cap.access.title: One alias, a set of upstreams behind it
portal.cap.access.desc: Clients just ask for sonnet. Your priorities and weights decide which upstream serves it.
portal.cap.access.affinity_note: A session sticks to one upstream for 5 minutes so its context cache stays warm.
portal.cap.curation.title: Conversations stop disappearing
portal.cap.curation.desc: Model interactions are grouped into sessions. Rate them and they become training data.
portal.cap.curation.export_note: Keeps multi-turn context, reasoning and tool calls
portal.cap.governance.title: Know who called what
portal.cap.governance.desc: Every call leaves a record, access is tiered, and content can be intercepted.
portal.cap.resilience.title: One bad upstream doesn't take the gateway down
portal.cap.resilience.desc: Too many errors trips the breaker. Requests fail fast instead of hanging, and recovery is probed on schedule.
portal.cap.resilience.caption_healthy: The upstream is healthy and requests go through.
portal.cap.resilience.caption_counting: Failures appear and the error rate is tracked.
portal.cap.resilience.caption_opened: 60% of 10 requests failed, above 50%. The breaker opens.
portal.cap.resilience.caption_rejecting: New requests get 503 + Retry-After right away instead of timing out.
portal.cap.resilience.caption_half_open: After 30 seconds it goes half-open and lets one probe through.
portal.cap.resilience.caption_recovered: The probe succeeds and traffic flows again.
portal.cap.resilience.bulkhead_label: Up to 32 concurrent requests per upstream. When full, wait 1s, then fail fast
portal.steps.heading: Four steps from zero to traceable
portal.steps.subtitle: No client code changes. Each step is a few clicks in the console or a single command.
portal.step.login.title: Sign in and get an API key
portal.step.login.desc: Sign in to the console with GitHub or Google. Once an admin approves you, create your own key on the API Keys page.
portal.step.upstream.title: Add upstreams and define aliases
portal.step.upstream.desc: Enter each vendor's base URL and key, or authorize a Codex / Claude Code subscription with OAuth. Then name an alias, bind upstreams to it, and set priorities and weights.
portal.step.install.title: Install aris and configure clients
portal.step.install.desc: Install the aris client with one command and enter the server address and key in the wizard. Then aris model export writes the available models into the clients you pick, backing up the originals.
portal.step.use.title: Keep working, data piles up
portal.step.use.desc: Code and chat as usual. Every call is audited and every conversation is saved as a session you can rate, share and export as a dataset.
portal.step.scene.key_hint: The key is shown only once. Keep it somewhere safe.
portal.closing.title: Put every model behind one address
portal.closing.subtitle: Set it up in minutes. Every call is traceable from then on.
